annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC), Colombia
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill filed in Congress on ethical and sustainable AI development
Risk-based approach with prohibited, high, limited and low risk tiers
Mechanisms against algorithmic bias, discrimination and privacy violations
Criminal and civil liability for misuse of AI; training programmes and mitigation of automation's labour impact
Aligned with OECD, UNESCO, EU, UK, Brazil, Argentina and Chile models
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: MinTIC news release announcing Colombia's ministers of ICT and Science filed a national AI bill in Congress. It proposes a risk-based framework (prohibited, high, limited, low), ethical and sustainable AI, bias and privacy safeguards, civil and criminal liability, workforce training and innovation promotion, aligned with OECD, UNESCO and EU models.
annotation.title_clean: Colombia elige una inteligencia artificial centrada en la vida, los derechos y el interés público con radicación del proyecto de ley de IA
annotation.title_en: Colombia chooses an artificial intelligence centred on life, rights and the public interest with the filing of the AI bill
annotation.venue: MinTIC (Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones) website
